notes: Other apps has a fourth card: UNote, a notebook where [[links]] connect the notes and a Vault sits behind a PIN you choose on first launch.
Its card says Open rather than Get because it is a page, not a store listing - it opens in the phone’s own browser and can be added to the home screen from there.
Nothing else about the tab moved: same place last before More, same card shape, same line under each name.
This one is in the page: it arrives the next time the app opens, with nothing to install.
